## Summary

Describe the change and the user or operator outcome.

## Verification

List the commands, platforms, and manual checks used to verify the change.

## Security and Compatibility

Describe any effect on credentials, authentication, network listeners, shells, Git, filesystems, agent permissions, stored data, upgrades, or mixed-version deployments. Write `None` when no boundary changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes relevant tests.
- [ ] Public documentation reflects changed behavior or configuration.
- [ ] User-interface labels follow the project Title Case convention.
- [ ] Fixtures, screenshots, logs, and generated files contain no credentials or private information.
- [ ] New documentation is product-focused and contains no competitor comparison material.
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes.
- [ ] Relevant tests and builds pass.
